_comment: claude: English texts of Soundtrack Finder
lang.title: Language
intro.user: Here you find the songs from movies and series. Pick a title to listen to its songs, correct them (length, name, split, delete, add) and save them to Jellyfin's music library. Changes apply for everyone and are marked with your name.
np.toggle: 🎵 While watching, show which song is playing (just for me)
np.nothing: Nothing is playing for you right now. Start a movie with songs – this shows whether and when a pop-up appears.
np.browserNotReady: ⚠ The browser hasn't reported pop-up support yet (happens after a Jellyfin restart). Reload the tab where the video is playing.
np.unsupported: ❌ This app can't show pop-ups (it doesn't support server messages).
np.noSongs: No songs recognized for this title.
np.tabs: ℹ {n} Jellyfin windows/tabs of this device are open – the pop-up appears in all of them.
np.noDevice: You aren't signed in on any device that is connected to Jellyfin right now.
np.testText: 🎵 Test: this is what "Now playing" looks like
status.title: Progress
status.etaUnknown: Time left: estimated after the first analyzed title.
btn.reanalyzeAllTitle: Check every title with Shazam again. Songs you added or edited by hand are kept. Can take hours, depending on your library.
app.linkLabel: Page for all users (listen, edit, save):
app.copied: Address copied – e.g. send it to your users.
status.taskHint: Soundtrack Finder's scheduled task runs daily at 2:00 AM by default (change it under Dashboard → Scheduled Tasks).
toast.analyzeOpenQueued: All open titles have been queued.
toast.reanalyzeQueued: {n} titles will be re-analyzed. Songs edited by hand are kept.
toast.exportAllStarted: All songs are being saved to Jellyfin in the background.
list.title: Titles
search.title: 🔎 Search & statistics
search.placeholder: Search for a song or artist, e.g. "A Thousand Years" or "Carter Burwell" …
toast.itemUnavailable: This title isn't available (or you don't have access).
tl.addTitle: Add a new song at the red cursor (or double-click the track)
tl.playCursorTitle: Play from the red cursor until you stop (Space)
tl.followTitle: The view follows the green playhead. Turns off as soon as you scroll yourself.
tl.exportItemStale: Save changed + all songs to Jellyfin
tl.zoomTitle: Zoom (also mouse wheel over the track)
legend.colors: grey = probable music · ● recognized · ● nothing recognized · ● excluded
tl.summaryOld: · music sections and Shazam samples appear after "Re-analyze"
tl.emptyList: No songs yet – double-click the track to add one.
d.title: Title
d.playSongTitle: Play the whole song from its start
d.playEndTitle: The last 15 s and 5 s beyond – for setting the end
d.splitTitle: Split into two songs at the red cursor (S)
d.mergeTitle: Merge with the next song into one
d.unexportTitle: Delete the saved MP3 from the music library; the song stays on the timeline
d.excludeTitle: Add the artist to the exclusion list and remove their recognized songs from all titles
toast.timeFormat: Please enter times as m:ss or h:mm:ss (e.g. 1:02:30).
toast.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
toast.splitHint: Put the red cursor (click the track) inside a song, then split.
toast.deletedExported: Song deleted (also removed from Jellyfin) – "Undo" brings it back.
toast.undoConflict: Can't undo: someone else has changed this title in the meantime. Showing the current version.
toast.upToDate: Everything was already up to date.
toast.unexported: {files} removed from Jellyfin. The songs stay on the timeline.
toast.nothingToRemove: None of these were saved in Jellyfin.
toast.playBlocked: The browser blocked playback – please click again.
toast.excluded: "{name}" is now on the exclusion list – {songs} removed.
set.title: Settings
set.librariesHint: No library selected = all movie and series libraries.
set.sensitivity: Music detection sensitivity (1 = strict, 10 = check everything)
set.writeOverview: Append the song list to the description
set.overviewLink: Next to "🎵 Songs", add a "▶ listen & edit" link to the Soundtracks page (opens exactly this title)
set.publicUrl: Public Jellyfin address for the link (e.g. https://jellyfin.example.com)
set.publicUrlHint: Leave empty = the link only works in the Jellyfin web app.
set.npEnabled: While watching, briefly show which song is playing (every user can turn it off for themselves)
set.npHint: Shown in apps that display server messages – reliably in the Jellyfin web app; apps without this feature are skipped.
set.excludeHint: One entry per line. Recognized songs whose "artist – title" contains one of these texts (case-insensitive) are ignored and removed from all analyzed titles – e.g. sound-effect libraries or cover versions. Songs added or edited by hand are always kept.
set.exportPath: Target folder for songs (path inside the container, e.g. /media/Soundtracks)
set.exportPathHint: The folder must be mounted writable and added to Jellyfin as a library of type "Music".
set.albumArtist: Album artist (all soundtracks appear under it in Jellyfin)
set.textLanguageHint: Used for the link in descriptions, the "Now playing" test message, the scheduled task, and folders and comments of saved songs. The page itself follows each user's language.
page.login: Please sign in to Jellyfin first (in this browser), then reload this page.
page.expired: Your Jellyfin sign-in has expired. Please sign in again, then reload this page.
page.unreachable: Soundtrack Finder can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
srv.splitInside: The split point must be inside the song.
srv.noTarget: No target folder set (Settings → "Target folder for songs").
srv.targetAbsolute: The target folder must be an absolute path inside the container, e.g. /media/Soundtracks.
srv.targetNotWritable: Target folder {root} isn't writable ({error}). Is it mounted in the container without :ro?
srv.noMusicLibrary: No music library contains {root}. The files are saved but only appear once you add a Jellyfin library of type "Music" with this folder.
srv.taskDescription: Recognizes songs in movies and episodes that haven't been analyzed yet, using Shazam.
